purpose: Deterministic, outcome-blind funnel deciding OPWS paired-analysis eligibility. No task is removed based on an observed OPWS result.

stages.name: frozen task universe
stages.scope: MAIN / frozen task universe (MAIN_297 manifest ordered task IDs)
stages.gate: task id present in the frozen manifest and in the future Full-D7 frame

stages.name: test evidence available
stages.scope: frozen evaluator F2P node set for the task
stages.source: frozen Full-D7 evaluator artifacts (BEHAVIORAL_F2P / SYMBOL_ABSENCE_F2P node records, bounded by frozen counts)
stages.gate: frozen per-task F2P count > 0 and node identities resolvable (no MISSING_F2P_NODES)

stages.name: adapter / behavior contract resolved
stages.scope: frozen behavior contract (adapter verified + E1 evaluator available + test command deterministic)
stages.gate: adapter resolved for the task; test command determined; evaluator boundary instantiable

stages.name: Full-D7 environment READY
stages.scope: environment readiness from the frozen Full-D7 READY census
stages.source: Full-D7 readiness records (negative + positive controls; READY decision) at final frozen census
stages.gate: frozen Full-D7 readiness record says READY (environment controls passed)
stages.note: ENV_READY alone does NOT imply OPWS_ELIGIBLE. This is exactly the distinction the mission requires.

stages.name: behavior contract executable on OPWS worktree
stages.scope: preflight that the frozen behavior contract can run against an OPWS-patched worktree (no patch-application or evaluator-runtime blocker)
stages.gate: dry preflight accepts the OPWS patching scheme; no PATCH_APPLICATION_INVALID / TEST_CONTRACT_INVALID at the eligibility layer

stages.name: OPWS eligible
stages.scope: task eligible for at least the diagnostic arms (GOLD / SELECT_ALL) under the OPWS contract
stages.gate: in_universe AND test_evidence AND behavior_contract AND env_ready AND behavior_executable

stages.name: primary paired eligible
stages.scope: task eligible for the PRIMARY paired comparison RM-CSS vs AGENT
stages.gate: opws_eligible AND both RM_CSS and AGENT frozen prediction artifacts resolve for the task (valid non-invalid scope recordings) AND GOLD validity control resolvable for the task

distinct_markers.OPWS_ELIGIBLE: environment-ready AND complete OPWS contract resolvable for the task
distinct_markers.PRIMARY_PAIRED_ELIGIBLE: OPWS eligible AND RM_CSS+AGENT scope artifacts + GOLD validity available (paired subpopulation)

eligibility_reason_codes.BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT_NOT_EXECUTABLE: behavior contract not executable on OPWS worktree
eligibility_reason_codes.PRIMARY_PAIRED_ELIGIBLE: OPWS eligible and paired scope artifacts + GOLD validity available
eligibility_reason_codes.PRIMARY_PAIRED_EXCLUDED_RMCSS_ARTIFACT: RM_CSS scope artifact invalid/missing for task
eligibility_reason_codes.PRIMARY_PAIRED_EXCLUDED_AGENT_ARTIFACT: AGENT scope artifact invalid/missing for task
eligibility_reason_codes.PRIMARY_PAIRED_EXCLUDED_GOLD_CONTROL: GOLD validity control not resolvable for task

hard_rules: No task may be removed from any eligibility stage based on an observed OPWS result.
OPWS scientific failures (BEHAVIOR_FAIL / PRESERVATION_FAIL / BEHAVIOR_AND_PRESERVATION_FAIL) on eligible tasks are data, never reasons to drop the task.
INFRASTRUCTURE / TEST_CONTRACT / ARM_PREDICTION invalids are recorded with exact reason codes in OPWS_INVALID_TASKS.json and reported; they are not silent exclusions.
Eligibility is evaluated once on the final frozen population; the eligibility manifest is hashed and bound with the population.
GOLD diagnostic failures tied to the behavior/preservation contract invalidate the task (OPWS_INVALID), not a scientific arm failure (see P8).
binding_note: The instantiated Full-D7 eligibility manifest (per-task stage outcomes and reason codes) is a LATER population-binding-era artifact. This freeze fixes only the funnel logic, stage order, gate definitions, markers, and reason-code vocabulary.
